comment: Venue registration records. One entry per venue per region. Provider sandbox only: paper trading is not a phase (ADR 0003), and a live path requires an accepted ADR (proposed ADR 0107).
comment2: Fields: venue_name (must match execution_nodes tfvars), region, operator_role (a role, never a personal email), registration_date, sandbox_api_key_secret (Secret Manager secret id for the provider sandbox), notes. There is deliberately no field for a production credential or a venue account identifier.
comment3: NEVER: put the actual API key here. Store in Secret Manager; put only the secret id.
